//: Deploy config for a THROWAWAY capacity-test service, not for the app.
//why: The capacity harness has to run OFF the box it measures, or the load generator competes for CPU with the server and the knee it finds is its own. This config builds the same image the app builds — so the harness and web3/proto/money.js are already inside it, with nothing to fetch at runtime — but starts test/load/loadtest.js instead of the server. Point a temporary service at this file (railwayConfigFile), set LOADGEN_BASE / LOADGEN_LEVELS / LOADGEN_SECONDS, deploy, read the logs, then DELETE the service.
//never: Never point this at the production app. The harness writes real sales into whatever ledger it reaches, and refuses hosts it can identify as production — a courtesy, not a guarantee.
